generationInputs.prompt: A vintage snark poster digitally illustrated with bold outlines and flat fills depicts a luminous pink donut, an eggplant, a banana, and a glowing white viscous liquid set against a stormy night with lightning and dense fog. The central pink donut, dripping pink liquid and white milk, is adorned with diamonds and pink sprinkles, appearing weightless with a holographic icing effect. Emerging from its center are two female legs in black fishnet stockings and black high-heeled shoes, while two hands extend, one holding a syringe with glowing liquid and the other a glass pipe. A vibrant, high-contrast eggplant and a banana, each holding a glowing syringe, float alongside the donut. The scene is bathed in warm oranges and cool blues/blacks, with strong highlights and shadows creating a graphic and stylized appearance.
